CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Thoughts and feelings? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Thoughts and feelings.
   B. Use Thoughts and feelings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Thoughts and feelings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Thoughts and feelings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Inspired Word of God.
   D. Say The Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Self-awareness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Self-awareness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self-awareness.
   C. Use Self-awareness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Self-awareness has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Joseph interprets a Dream? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Joseph interprets a Dream with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Joseph interprets a Dream.
   C. Say Joseph interprets a Dream has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Joseph interprets a Dream to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Balaam’s Donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Balaam’s Donkey has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Balaam’s Donkey to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Balaam’s Donkey.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zacchaeus the Tax Collector.
   B. Say Zacchaeus the Tax Collector has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Zacchaeus the Tax Collector to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of My Family Family members? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Family Family members to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Family Family members.
   C. Say My Family Family members has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Annunciation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Annunciation.
   B. Use The Annunciation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Annunciation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. Which response best shows understanding of Making choices? (1 mark)
   A. Say Making choices has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Making choices.
   C. Apply the teaching of Making choices with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Making choices to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Obedience and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Love and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Responsibility Personal and school items and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Holiness and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. A — Apply the teaching of Balaam’s Donkey with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of Zacchaeus the Tax Collector with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of My Family Family members with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of The Annunciation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Obedience; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
